result.final_text:
## What this letter says
You met your doctor on 28 September 2026. You talked about treatment options for your bowel cancer.

You have decided not to start chemotherapy at this time. This is not a final decision. You can change your mind at any time.

Dr Chen will see you again in clinic in 4 weeks.

## What you need to do
1. You can call the cancer nurse specialist team on 01632 960 471 if you would like to talk before your clinic visit.
2. Dr Chen will see you again in clinic in 4 weeks.

## Dates and medicines
- 28 September 2026: you met the doctor to talk about treatment options.
- In 4 weeks: Dr Chen will see you again in clinic.
- Medicines: the letter lists no medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What will happen at my next clinic visit?
- If I change my mind about chemotherapy, what are the next steps?
- Who can I talk to before my clinic visit?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
